mapper.insert: INSERT INTO slot (schedule_id, doctor_id, schedule_date, period, seq_num, start_time, end_time, status, is_extra, version) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{doctorId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{period}, #{seqNum}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{isExtra}, #{version})
